cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(typeaside_llama LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(LLAMA_VERSION_BASE "0.0.0")
set(LLAMA_VERSION "c06f841")
set(LLAMA_VERSION_MAJOR 0)
set(LLAMA_BUILD_NUMBER 0)
set(LLAMA_BUILD_COMMIT "c06f84160a30c66d7b5a2829ae9b3ea15275cbc3")
# The Rust transcribe dependency owns all ggml libraries and their link directives.
add_library(ggml INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(ggml INTERFACE "${TRANSCRIBE_INCLUDE_DIR}")
function(llama_add_compile_flags)
endfunction()
add_subdirectory(llama/src)
install(TARGETS llama ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
